description: Multi-output ridge regression on log-counts with within-trial acausal temporal context. We model the expected spike counts of 35 held-out neurons from 107 observed neurons using a linear readout applied to lagged features of the observed population. Steps: (1) log1p-transform observed and target counts; (2) build a symmetric within-trial temporal window of observed activity (±5 bins, zero-padded at trial edges so no information crosses trial boundaries); (3) flatten trials×time to a design matrix; (4) select the ridge regularization strength via 5-fold GroupKFold cross-validation over trials to avoid leakage across the same trial; (5) fit a single multi-target Ridge to predict log1p(targets) from standardized lagged features; (6) predict on test, invert with expm1, clip to nonnegative finite counts. Offline acausal context is only within the same trial, no joining/smoothing across trials. Outputs are expected counts per 20 ms bin with shape (100, 35, 35), finite and nonnegative. Deterministic seed is set.
